review_reference: Owner decisions in chat by D-Eminence, relayed by the coordinator, for 0114 (collect the sign-up fields; numbered 0122 when written, renumbered 0114 by the coordinator on 2026-11-11 because staging ends at 0111 and 0112 and 0113 release first): "don't remove them instead we need to collect those information" and "allow trading name, all fields required". Every field of facility sign-up, the setup wizard and staff patient registration is required on the website, except the three document uploads (operating licence, CAC certificate, proof of address) and the facility logo, which stay deferred until the document bucket and its scanner exist. The other decisions take the plan's recommended defaults: D1 CAC legal name kept, trading name collected; D2 the directory keeps the registered address; D3 E.164 8-15 digits, facility_alert_phones not seeded; D4 Medical Director name and MDCN collected, the applicant's phone stored encrypted; D6 state from the 37, LGA free text required; D7 departments a fixed code list; D8 the facility administrator edits after activation at self-service facilities; D9 sealed demo facilities refused; D10 the desk's patient phone and address facility-held, unverified, encrypted; D11 allergies not collected at the desk; D12 provisional local identity off; D13 a stated Health ID is a hint only: it never adds a review candidate (review finding: that would show staff a patient who gave the facility no consent and make a typo linkable); it marks with stated_hid a patient who is already a candidate by name and date of birth, and link-existing refuses a candidate whose only reason is stated_hid. RELEASE ORDER (review finding): the new sign-up and desk fields are optional in the API, all or none, so the live website keeps working: 1. this backend, 2. the website that always sends the fields, 3. a follow-up backend release that makes them required. UNSIGNED: reviewed_by stays empty until the owner signs. Coordinator, 2026-11-11 ~20:20 UTC: staging (0112 and 0113, both live) merged in; 0114 sha256 unchanged; runtime-grants.sql sha256 moved from 2ed3f2c8… to 8cb6cfe8… only because the file now carries the live 0112/0113 blocks (0114's own grants block verified byte-identical). Release subject to the owner's re-confirmation in Q51.
evidence: Migration 0114_collect_signup_fields.sql (numbered 0122 when written, renumbered 0114 on 2026-11-11), and services/ehr-api/database/runtime-grants.sql, which gains 0114's grant block, as the release requires every changed file under services/ehr-api/database/ to be declared (#224). WHAT IT DOES: new tables identity.nigeria_states (37 rows), identity.facility_profiles, identity.registration_case_contacts and identity.patient_facility_contacts (forced row-level security); identity.registration_cases is not altered; a new 11-argument identity.begin_self_service_provider_enrollment beside 0086's 7-argument one (unchanged, still granted); an AFTER UPDATE OF status trigger on identity.organization_applications that copies the confirmed code's profile to the facility on approval (self-service activation and administrator approval); identity.read_facility_profile() and identity.set_facility_profile(bigint,jsonb,text,char) (workforce.manage, self-service facility, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, audit with field names only). DELETION RULE (NDPA, 0084's rule): the desk's encrypted phone and address and the stated Health ID (identity.registration_case_contacts) and every facility's copy (identity.patient_facility_contacts) are never deleted and never changed except by erasure, which sets the ciphertexts, key version and stated Health ID to null and records erased_at and erasure_reason (a guard trigger allows nothing else, once). Erasure is the owner-only identity.erase_patient_facility_contacts(uuid,text) (no runtime grant; audited with counts only): an AFTER UPDATE OF state trigger on identity.patient_account_deletion_requests calls it when an account deletion completes ('account_deleted'), and Health ID support has it run through the owner for an NDPA erasure request ('erasure_request'); it also removes the patient's Health ID (current or earlier) from any other person's case that stated it, leaving that person's phone and address (the guard allows that one change). A case that never became a patient (rejected, cancelled, never reviewed) is erased by case with the owner-only identity.erase_registration_case_contact(uuid,text) ('erasure_request'; no runtime grant; audited with counts only). The owner policies follow the tables' owner (pg_has_role on pg_class.relowner), not the role that applied 0114, and both erasure functions refuse (42501) unless they run as a member of the owner of both contact tables, so a later owner change fails loudly instead of erasing nothing. No existing function body, policy or grant is replaced. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: no existing table gains a column; today's Identity calls the 7-argument command and never reads the new objects; the new Identity accepts the old sign-up and desk bodies (new fields all or none). BASELINE: written on 0001-0108 and brought up to staging cbafbdbe (0109, 0110 and 0111 live). 0114 touches no object that 0109-0113 create or replace (0109: identity.support_health_id_matches; 0110 and 0111: outreach triggers, policies and outreach.campaign_staff; 0112: ocr source deletion and ehr.documents; 0113: ehr.encounters, ocr.publications, clinical-note draft guards and identity.records_processing_write_grant). PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only, nothing applied): not applied yet (55000 '0114: already applied'); 0001-0111 applied, 0111's outreach.campaign_staff(uuid) the marker (55000 '0114: 0001-0111 must be applied first'); the applier owns the tables it adds triggers to (42501). PROOF (re-proved 2026-11-11 after the renumbering, on a throwaway local PostgreSQL 16.15 UTF-8 cluster, created for this and deleted, never a real database): (1) fresh install 0001-0111 then 0114 by the migration runner, role bootstrap and verify-roles passed; all 16 database/tests suites and all 69 test/database suites passed (85, including collect-signup-fields.integration.sql and patient-account-deletion; re-run on a new throwaway cluster after the erasure review fix, which added erasure by case, removal of a stated Health ID, and the owner check), db:plan 0 pending; re-running 0114 refuses '0114: already applied'; on 0001-0110 without 0111 it refuses '0114: 0001-0111 must be applied first'. (2) Release order 0112, 0113, 0114: with 0112 and 0113 taken from their branches (#226, #229) and runtime-grants.sql merged with #229's, a fresh install 0001-0114, bootstrap and verify-roles passed, the same 85 suites passed and #226/#229's 3 new suites passed, db:plan 0 pending. (3) verify-order-routes-runtime.mjs (25 steps) and verify-records-processing-runtime.mjs (7 steps) passed on a loopback copy with the new sign-up fields and check the activated facility's profile. scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs passed (113 immutable migrations, 0114 accepted). The release contract reports 'missing migration prefix' until 0112 and 0113 are on staging.
